pages.text: A kit is a bundle of items the server hands out. Open the kit browser with the KITS button above your inventory, a key you bind in Controls, or $(l)/kits$().$(br2)Every kit you may see is a card: its picture, its name, and what stands between you and it.

A green card is ready: press REDEEM on it and the items land in your inventory.$(br2)A grey card is one you took lately. It says how long until it is ready again, or that it was once only.$(br2)A card with a rank on it needs that rank; the steps show where you stand and how far there is to go. A card naming a server is taken on that server. A price in pieces comes from your bank account. A card counting slots needs that much room in your inventory first.
pages.title: Reading a card

pages.text: A kit given to you as a reward, or at your first login, waits in violet when it did not fit or came while you were away. Free the slots it names and press TAKE IT.$(br2)Nothing is lost: a kit that cannot fit stays waiting until it can.
pages.title: Waiting for you

pages.text: Click a card's picture to see what is in the kit, with the counts, and every condition ticked or crossed. BACK returns to the wall.$(br2)On a network your kits and what you have taken are the same on every server.
pages.title: Looking inside
